parsed.internal_thinking: Sean is trying to consolidate his lead. He has 5 Wheat and 2 Ore. By trading 2 Wheat for 1 Ore from Ziv, he will have 3 Ore and 3 Wheat—exactly what he needs to build a city (3 Ore, 2 Wheat). He's framing it as 'helping' Ziv, but it's clearly a move to upgrade. Ziv should know better, but they have a history of side deals. I need to call this out to prevent Sean from pulling ahead while my Wheat is still blocked.
